messages.subject: Line transect census
parts:
Hi everybody,=20
=20
I'm trying to set up my project using New Project Setup Wizard, but in st=
ep 5 (Multipliers) there is no place to check when g(0)=3D1. Where can I =
find that?
=20
Thanks,
=20
Natalia

Clark Jones <Cl...@TTRS.ORG> escribi=F3:
Hi all,
I am doing point transects for a single species of bird, Bachman's
Sparrow, to determine effects of growing season prescribed fire.
Sometimes I don't count any Sparrows at a point, consequently I have
zero birds for that point. Since Distance makes it's calculations when
I input a distance, how do I input zero detections? I guess my question
is really just a matter of syntax....how do I make sure that Distance
knows that I surveyed the point and found zero birds. Please let me
know if this question needs clarification.
thanks,
clark jones

messages.subject: Re: Line transect census
parts:
Hi Natalia, list,

The default in Distance is to assume g(0)=1 so you don't need to tick anything
in step 5 (you don't need any multipliers).

Cheers, - Len
